Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

**Manager, Strategy & Execution

**

• Location: Copenhagen / Lisbon

• Work model: Hybrid / Full time

Do you want to lead projects that influence the future direction of global business? Are you curious about how to keep a strategy alive across a global organization? Are you excited by working closely with experienced leaders to solve the most challenging problems in our business? Then you might be who we are looking for!

You will be part of our Strategy & Execution team and work on high-impact, cross-functional projects that help drive STG's strategy forward. You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

• Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency

• Project managing complex, cross-functional projects

• Creating insightful analysis (gathering, testing, combining, summarising, visualising)

• Developing frameworks to bring simplicity and clarity to complex problems and decisions

• Working closely with experts and stakeholders to identify and refine recommendations

• Running workshops with senior leaders

• Building slide decks to tell a compelling message

• Managing and supporting the development of more junior team member(s)

• 
You will bring a minimum of 3-4 years of strategy and/or management consulting experience

Experience in a corporate environment (permanent or secondments) is a plus

• 
Problem and decision structuring – experience building frameworks to simplify challenges and decisions to enable the business to move forward

• 
Experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods and/or Retail sectors

• 
Demonstrated project management experience and attention to detail

• 
Strong stakeholder management and team working experience

• 
Demonstrated strong analytical skills including experience delivering complex analyses in Excel

• 
Understanding P&L / key accounting principles / Cashflow modelling is a plus

• 
Understanding of data structuring principles and leveraging multiple data sources a plus

• 
Good slide development skills (storyboarding, content development, polishing) for C-level messaging

• 
A learning and growth mindset – developing yourself and supporting the development of the team around you

• 
Experience and curiosity in using GenAi tools to accelerate and improve your work, including effective prompting, iterative refinement and critical evaluation of AI outputs

•

What You’ll Learn

•

• 
This could include:

•

• 
Refining your presentation skills, to communicate complex topics in a clear and effective way

• 
Leading projects that are critical to our strategy success

• 
Strengthening your stakeholder management skills in a complex, cross-functional, international organization

• 
This role will give exposure to senior leaders across business globally and equip you to be a transformation leader with extensive experience working alongside C-suite

• 
Our Strategy department, which brings together teams focused on strategy execution, consumer insights, business intelligence, data, and sustainability, will provide you with an opportunity to broaden your expertise across these disciplines too

At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact. jobs.description:
Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Global Business Owner, Global Procurement to be based in Ballerup, Denmark

In this role, you will lead Global Procurement through our global ERP, QMS and PLM transformation, turning functional strategy into harmonized processes, clear decisions and measurable value. You will report to the Global Operations Program Director, with functional anchoring to the VP Global Procurement, and work closely with Global Process Owners, site leadership, IT, Finance, Quality and implementation partners.

This is a unique opportunity to shape a major global transformation and challenge established ways of working. It will suit an experienced procurement leader who enjoys bridging business and technology and driving change at scale.

**Key Responsibilities

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Developing the transformation roadmap, target operating model and benefit case for Global Procurement

• Representing Global Procurement in program governance and making timely decisions

• Driving simplification, harmonization and adoption across sites

• Ensuring processes, data and systems meet quality and regulatory requirements

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have leadership experience within Global Procurement

• Hold a degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Have strong knowledge of global operations and end-to-end processes

• Come from medical devices, life sciences, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry

• Have delivered major business transformation or enterprise system implementations

• Have strong executive presence and can influence across functions and sites

• Have ERP, QMS or PLM experience (ideally Infor M3 or Dassault Systèmes) and are flexible to travel internationally

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**Technical Services Manager – VELUX Skjern

****Are you an experienced technical leader who thrives on combining strategic direction with operational excellence? Join our production site in Skjern and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of advanced manufacturing, driving technical performance, digitalisation, and continuous improvement across a highly automated production environment.

****Meet your future team

**As Technical Manager, you will be based in Skjern and report directly to the General Manager. You will lead a diverse and highly skilled Technical Services organisation consisting of Project Engineers, Engineering Specialists within mechanical and electronic engineering and analytics, and a Maintenance team of experienced technicians. Together, the team plays a crucial role in ensuring equipment reliability, delivering technical projects, and supporting production excellence.

You will become part of both local and international leadership forums, collaborating closely with colleagues across Operations, Engineering, Quality and Production. The role offers significant influence and autonomy, enabling you to identify opportunities, drive improvements and contribute to the continued development of a mature Lean culture built on VELUX values.

A key focus in the coming years will be the optimisation of a highly automated production facility in Skjern, which will serve as a blueprint for future implementation at one of our production sites in France.

**What We Offer

**In this role, you will lead technical operations across the site while supporting the organisation's strategic ambitions around operational performance, innovation and manufacturing excellence. You will have the opportunity to influence both people and processes, ensuring that technical capabilities continue to evolve in line with business needs.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

• Lead and develop the Technical Services organisation through values-based leadership, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, safety and technical excellence.

• Ensure high levels of equipment availability, reliability and performance across production operations.

• Develop and strengthen team capabilities within engineering, technical project management, maintenance and digitalisation.

• Drive equipment stability, process optimisation and digital transformation initiatives while delivering against operational KPIs and global standards.

• Identify, evaluate and implement innovative technologies, systems and working methods that enhance productivity, quality and efficiency.

• Support the installation, integration and optimisation of new machinery and production technologies across the site.

• Collaborate with local and international stakeholders to deliver strategic projects and share best practices across the organisation.

**What You Will Bring

**You are an experienced people leader who enjoys developing teams and creating an environment where individuals can perform at their best. You combine technical expertise with strong business understanding and are equally comfortable defining strategic priorities and ensuring successful execution.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring proven leadership experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment, preferably within a larger international organisation.

• Hold a relevant technical qualification such as Engineering, Production Technology, Marine Engineering or a comparable discipline.

• Have substantial experience leading technical, engineering, maintenance or project teams.

• Possess a strong understanding of Lean principles, operational excellence and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Have experience driving technical development, automation, digitalisation or production improvement initiatives.

• Communicate effectively across all organisational levels and build strong relationships based on trust, collaboration and mutual respect.

• Are fluent in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match. All enquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

**What We Achieve Together

**At Vaillant, service plays a vital role in our customers’ everyday lives. That is why we are looking for a Service Coordinator who is motivated by bringing structure to a busy workday, coordinating activities across multiple stakeholders, and ensuring a high-quality customer experience. As a key member of our Service team, you will play an important role in ensuring that our customers receive the service they expect and deserve.

In this role, you will work closely with technicians, customers, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient and professional service delivery. You will be part of our Service team and report directly to the Technical Support Manager.

• You will plan and coordinate service visits, start-ups, and other service activities to ensure our customers receive timely and professional support.

• Through close collaboration with customers, technicians, and internal stakeholders, you will ensure that service activities are prioritized and completed efficiently.

• Your responsibilities will include managing service agreements, create work orders, and follow up on planned service activities.

• Together with the Service team, you will contribute to effective resource planning and help optimize technician utilization.

• You will coordinate spare parts and support procurement activities to ensure technicians have the necessary materials to carry out their work.

• By working proactively and maintaining a structured approach, you will contribute to continuous process improvements and high levels of customer satisfaction.

**What Makes Us Successful Together

**

• You hold a relevant administrative, commercial, or technical qualification and are motivated by working in a coordinating role

• You have experience from a service coordination, planning, customer service, or administrative position, ideally within a technical or service-oriented environment

• You have strong organizational and planning skills, work in a structured manner, and are comfortable using administrative systems and Microsoft Office applications

• Experience working within a service organization or coordinating field service technicians would be considered an advantage

• You are proactive, solution-oriented, and thrive in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism

• You are fluent in Danish, both written and spoken, and feel comfortable communicating in English within an international organization

**What You Can Count On

**

• You will be working out of our beautiful new HQs in Taastrup that have been designed to unite and inspire our teams.

• We also invite you to come and enjoy our lunch in our canteen. The restaurant offers an affordable service for all residents and visitors.

• At Vaillant, you will become part of a company with strong values, a high level of expertise, and a shared ambition to create sustainable solutions for the future of energy. We offer a collaborative and supportive work environment, opportunities for professional development, and a role where your contribution has a visible impact on both our customers and our business.

**What Makes Us Special

**We take care of a better climate. In every home and our environment. As a successful family business, we have been living up to this claim for over 150 years. We are one of the world's leading providers of heat pumps, digital services and efficient gas heating appliances and offer energy-saving solutions.

You will find sustainability everywhere at the Vaillant Group. In the office, at the production sites and on the road. Around 16,000 employees from over 70 countries are committed to this every day. As an international team, we take responsibility - for our future and that of our planet. We promote your personal development so that you can act with passion and together we can ensure a better climate.

Become part of the Vaillant Group and help us shape the future of heating!

**We promote equity and do not tolerate any form of discrimination. We value the uniqueness of each individual and encourage all people to apply.

**Your impact begins here

**As Accounting Manager, you will take full ownership of accounting and tax activities for your area in Business Area (BA) West and become the trusted first point of contact for the local Finance & Operations (F&O) Head and Line of Business. You will keep financial reporting accurate, timely and compliant, especially at month-end and year-end, and help make accounting simpler and more digital. Your work gives local teams the clarity to make decisions and keep moving at pace.

**What You’ll Bring

**You combine strong technical accounting with the confidence to partner with the business and challenge constructively.

• A master’s degree in business, finance, economics or a similar field.

• 5–8 years of relevant experience from finance, consulting, auditing or a comparable background.

• Solid experience in accounting and financial reporting, including month-end and year-end closing.

• Strong technical accounting skills and the ability to handle complex accounting matters.

• Experience performing financial controls and working within a control framework.

• Strong stakeholder-management and business-partnering skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting topics clearly to Finance and non-Finance colleagues.

• Knowledge of SAP.

• A structured, analytical and detail-oriented approach, and the ability to prioritise and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

• A proactive, collaborative mindset, with the confidence to take ownership.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be accountable for the quality of accounting in your area and a visible partner to the people who depend on it.

• Take full accounting responsibility for your assigned area, with the tax activities that go with it.

• Act as first point of contact for the local F&O Head and Line of Business, giving accounting advice and business partnering.

• Perform complex accounting tasks during month-end close (MEC) and year-end close (YEC), delivering accurate, timely and compliant financial reporting.

• Carry out financial controls and make sure control activities are completed effectively and on time.

• Investigate accounting issues, identify risks and drive them to resolution.

• Improve accounting processes and ways of working through standardisation, simplification and digitalisation.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Accounting & Taxation BA West Centre of Excellence (CoE), based in Copenhagen (Ørestad), and report to the Associate Director Accounting & Taxation CoE. The CoE is responsible for accounting and tax across nine affiliates in 11 countries: Denmark & Iceland, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium & Luxembourg, Finland, Ireland and Portugal.

The team includesAccounting Managers and controllers who act as dedicated finance partners to individual affiliates, while two positions focus on the Business Area as a whole. Your closest partners will be the local F&O Head and Line of Business for your area, alongside colleagues across the wider Accounting & Taxation organisation. Together you build standardised, efficient ways of working that support high-quality financial management.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to own your area and make your voice heard, with clear expectations for the quality and timeliness of your work. You will grow by working across markets, stakeholders and finance disciplines, and by contributing to how accounting is improved and digitalised across Business Area West. You will be supported by colleagues who give and ask for honest feedback so that everyone can perform at their best.

• Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 650,960.00 to 956,860.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to own accounting in your area and partner with the business to deliver high-quality results, upload your CV and apply before 19.11.2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Department: Global Manufacturing & Supply – CMC Clinical Supplies, Digital Solutions

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As IT Project Manager, you will lead complex IT projects that keep the GxP systems behind Clinical Supplies reliable, compliant and ready for what comes next. By aligning business, IT, Quality and vendors, you help deliver the systems that support clinical trial supply, on time and in line with regulatory requirements. You will turn complex dependencies into clear plans and decisions, so specialist teams can focus on delivery.

**What You’ll Bring

**You have led complex IT projects from start to finish and know how to deliver in a highly governed setting.

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT, engineering, life sciences, business, supply chain or a related field.

• Extensive experience managing cross-functional IT projects, with genuine end-to-end ownership of scope, timeline, budget and risks.

• Experience delivering projects that involve multiple systems, organisational areas and external vendors.

• Experience managing system integrations, APIs, interfaces and data exchange between enterprise systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you understand the technology well enough to manage dependencies and risks.

• Experience working in a regulated environment. Pharma, life sciences and medical devices are relevant, and so are banking, energy, defence and other highly controlled industries.

• Experience coordinating testing, validation, documentation, change control and implementation activities.

• You navigate diverse stakeholder interests, build alignment and drive collaboration across technical teams, business functions and senior management.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

• Experience with project governance, budget follow-up, resource planning and status reporting, including clear communication of project status and costs to stakeholders.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience with MES (for example PAS-X), Interactive Response Technology, Computer System Validation, GAMP 5 or regulated cloud and SaaS solutions.

• A recognised project management certification, such as PRINCE2 or PMP.

• Experience combining agile ways of working with structured project governance.

**What You’ll Do

**You will own delivery of IT projects in a regulated GxP environment, creating structure and keeping everyone moving in the same direction.

• Lead projects from initiation and planning through implementation to structured handover to system ownership, support and business operations.

• Drive integration and API projects between GxP and business-critical systems, aligning requirements, solution design, interfaces and data flows.

• Manage scope, milestones, budget, resources, risks, dependencies and decisions.

• Coordinate testing, validation, release readiness and cutover, making sure deliverables meet GxP, quality, security and privacy requirements.

• Manage vendor deliverables and performance together with Procurement and relevant internal functions.

• Give senior stakeholders transparent reporting and clear decision material, and lead business readiness, training and procedural updates.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the IT team for GxP systems within Clinical Supplies, part of Global Manufacturing & Supply in CMC. In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain to scale molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them.

Your team is based in Denmark and works closely with colleagues in India, while a sister team looks after non-GxP systems. Across the systems landscape, around 40 IT professionals may be involved in your projects, together with external partners.

Day to day, you will partner with Product Owners, System Managers, Solution Architects, developers, validation specialists, Quality Assurance and business representatives. A fellow Project Manager will be your peer and sparring partner.

**What You Can Expect Here

**This is a role with real ownership. You will step into a project that is already moving, with a growing pipeline of IT projects behind it, and you will be trusted to shape how it is delivered. You will have a peer Project Manager to learn from and challenge your thinking, and the chance to broaden your skills across systems, vendors and functions. Clear expectations and honest feedback help you perform at your best.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to 956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring structure and momentum to complex GxP integration projects, apply for the IT Project Manager role by 13 November 2026. Please submit your CV in English. We review applications as they arrive, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.description:
_**Would you like to play a key role in driving high-quality financial control, governance, and technical accounting across an international Group – with flexibility in how you structure your work?

**_Working on complex and business-critical topics, including audits, IFRS, acquisitions, and financial reporting, you will influence processes, shape best practices, and strengthen governance frameworks and internal controls across the Group.

Join us and build your expertise in a leading international healthcare company dedicated to improving the lives of people with intimate healthcare needs worldwide.

**Our Group Controlling and Reporting team is ready to welcome you

**At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will become part of the Group Controlling and Reporting team within Corporate Finance. Here, you will join a close-knit team of seven colleagues who support subsidiaries across the globe and are responsible for reviews, reporting, and controlling activities. We foster a friendly, inclusive, and professional environment with a high degree of flexibility, where collaboration is strong, new ideas are always welcomed and heard, and we make a point of having fun together when we come to work.

**Be the key finance partner across the Group

**As Senior Financial Controller, you will serve as a key finance partner across the Group, providing expertise within IFRS, technical accounting, financial controlling, and governance.

This entails acting as a subject matter expert on complex accounting areas and being the finance contact towards acquired entities. You will also be the one to strengthen internal controls and governance frameworks.

Specifically, you will:

• Prepare accounting memorandums, supporting key accounting positions.

• Act as contact towards external auditors and prepare audit documentation.

• Own PPA preparation and follow-up in connection with acquisitions.

• Perform monthly controlling of subsidiaries and key business areas.

• Execute financial reviews and drive follow-up on identified risks.

• Handle and prepare annual reports together with the team for both the Group and the parent company.

**You combine strong financial expertise with a business-oriented mindset

**In this role, you need to have the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, taking ownership of activities and projects as well as engaging and collaborating with stakeholders across functions and geographies. Also, your exceptional business insight and perceptive mindset enable you to effectively organise and prioritise tasks, while identifying practical solutions to complex challenges.

**About The Job

**GetWhy is the end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform trusted by the world’s most influential brands, including eBay, Arla, Warner Brothers and The Coca Cola company, to understand their customers at scale. We’re backed by $40M in Series A funding and scaling aggressively into the enterprise market.

In our category, events aren’t a nice-to-have. They are a strategic weapon. Industry conferences, hosted experiences, executive dinners and brand activations are where relationships form, pipeline is built, and GetWhy cements its position as the category leader in AI-powered qualitative research.

We’re hiring our first Lead, Global Events & Community to own how GetWhy shows up in the world. This is a high-ownership role for someone with taste, commercial instinct and relentless execution. You’ll design experiences enterprise buyers actually want to attend, turn every event into content that travels far beyond the room, and build the playbook that lets GetWhy show up brilliantly on every continent.

What you’ll do

Own the global event strategy

• Set GetWhy’s global events strategy with the marketing leadership, from tentpole industry conferences (IIEX, ESOMAR, Quirk’s) to hosted events, executive roundtables and product showcases.

• Plan, produce and execute 15–20+ events per year across Europe, the US and beyond, each tied to clear pipeline, brand and customer goals.

Make GetWhy unmissable at every conference

Put customers on stage

Own the side events and intimate moments

Run the content machine

Turn events into revenue

Build the playbook

• Grow the events function over time, including freelancers, agencies and future hires.

• Stay ahead of new event formats and technologies, and bring the best of them to GetWhy first.

You’re not looking for an event coordination role. You’re a builder who sees events as the highest-leverage channel in a B2B enterprise sale, and you want to prove it on a global stage.

• 3–6+ years in event marketing, field marketing or experiential marketing for B2B SaaS, enterprise tech or a high-growth scale-up.

• Comfortable with CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

• A willing traveler. You go where the events are and you bring the energy.

• Experience at an AI-native research company or a frontier AI or tech company known for its events.

• You’ve built an events function from scratch, including playbooks, processes and measurement.

• You’ve produced a flagship owned event or customer conference.

• A fast-scaling, ambitious company where events are a core growth engine, not an afterthought.

• The chance to build GetWhy’s global events function from the ground up and define how a category leader shows up in the world.

If we see a match, we’ll invite you to a conversation online or at our office. The process includes a short creative assignment, where you’ll pitch how GetWhy should show up at one of our key industry conferences.

Are you passionate about pharmacometrics and model-informed drug development? Do you have experience with translational and clinical population PK/PD modeling and support of regulatory submissions?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician.

We are looking for a hands-on pharmacometrician who combines scientific excellence with strategic thinking and wants broad ownership across programs.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our Pharmacometrics Department supports every asset in the Ascendis portfolio and acts as a strategic partner throughout development, from innovation and early research through translational and clinical development, regulatory submissions, and life cycle management. Each pharmacometrician contributes directly to development strategy and portfolio decisions.

We are seeking an experienced hands-on Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician who can address complex development questions and translate quantitative insights into actionable recommendations. You will apply model-informed drug development in rare diseases, where quantitative methods can directly inform trial design, dose selection, and evidence generation in small patient populations. You will gain exposure across translational and development stages and contribute to projects throughout the portfolio, providing broad visibility and influence within the company.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results. You will work both independently and in close collaboration with colleagues in Pharmacometrics, global project teams, external partners, and consultants. You will be joining the growing Pharmacometrics Department and report directly to Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics, who is based in Hellerup. You will also be based in Hellerup. The team includes in-house pharmacometricians, a pharmacometrics programmer, and external consultants working remotely.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• 
Develop model-informed drug development strategies for translational and clinical-stage projects and ensure optimal use of pharmacometric methods to inform trial and program design

• 
Shape regulatory strategy and represent pharmacometrics in global health authority interactions

• 
Inform dose selection, trial design, regulatory strategy, and lifecycle decisions through population PK/PD modeling, simulation, exposure-response analysis, and quantitative benefit-risk assessment

• 
Translate quantitative results into clear recommendations to project teams, senior management, health authorities, external partners or organizations

• 
Plan, document and report pharmacometric analyses in accordance with internal quality standards and global regulatory submission requirements

• 
Strengthen departmental methods, standards and capabilities through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and continued development of the department's modeling and reporting environment

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a PhD, MSc, or equivalent qualification in pharmacometrics, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacokinetics, mathematics, engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline. You have relevant experience with PK/PD modeling and model-informed drug development.

Furthermore, you have:

• Hands-on experience with NONMEM and R applied to population PK/PD model development, simulation, and model-informed drug development

• Strong programming skills and technical expertise to organize, perform, document, and report pharmacometric analyses to submission standard

• Experience with translational and clinical-stage analyses, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose selection, and trial-design questions

Additional experience that would be an advantage:

• Industrial experience supporting regulatory interactions or submissions, including knowledge of relevant FDA, EMA, and ICH expectations for pharmacometric analyses

• Familiarity with LaTeX, Git and reproducible reporting workflows, or experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or automation to pharmacometric workflows

Key competencies:

• You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude

• You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key

• You communicate complex quantitative findings clearly, work effectively across disciplines, and balance analytical detail with broader development objectives

• You combine a strong quantitative background with biological and clinical understanding and collaborate effectively with scientists, clinicians, regulatory colleagues, and external partners. Your ability to share knowledge and contribute to common goals will be valued among colleagues

Travel: 5-10 days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup, Denmark.

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform—applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For further information about the position, please contact Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics at kcp@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com.

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team—specifically a Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director—is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

PanTarg is a Danish biotechnology company developing novel anti-cancer therapies in the form of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for the treatment of aggressive cancers with high unmet medical need.

Our work is based on more than 30 years of research conducted at Rigshospitalet and University of Copenhagen, and our vision is to enable novel treatment options for cancer patients via a novel first-in-class approach to targeted therapy.

We are currently incubated at the BioInnovation Institute (BII), a Copenhagen-based incubation hub for biotech startups in Europe. Here, we are currently progressing through preclinical development, aiming to reach a stage of clinical testing within a few years.

The position

We are looking for a Staff Scientist to join our team on site at BII. We are looking for a candidate with robust experimental experience with both in vivo xenograft studies as well as in vitro methods such as assay development, ELISA, flow cytometry and dose-response studies of drug candidates in cell culture. The selected candidate will generate data that supports our early translational activities, our non-clinical safety studies, and business decisions.

Qualifications

In vivo experience – Xenograft models

• Robust (5+ years) of hands-on experience with xenograft models of cancer, including CDX, PDX and orthotopic models.

• Strong practical experience with standard in vivo procedures, including I.V. injection via tail vein (must-have), blood collection, tissue collection, necropsy and general animal monitoring. Experience in preparing drug formulations and dosing solutions for administration, including appropriate handling and preparation of injectable drug candidates, is also required.

• Experience in the context of pharmacokinetic (PK) studies will be considered an advantage.

• Experience in planning, conducting and monitoring in vivo studies, as well as managing external CROs conducting such studies.

In vitro experience – Laboratory assays and protein characterization

• 5+ years of hands-on laboratory experience, with a strong focus on assay development, optimization and protocol troubleshooting.

• Experience with relevant assays and techniques, including ELISA, flow cytometry (multicolor panels) and dose-response studies of drug candidates in standard cell culture models.

• Good understanding of antibody biology and properties, as well as protein characterization, antibody concentration determination and purity assessment using techniques such as UV-Vis spectrophotometry, SDS-PAGE and Western blotting.

• Experience with additional laboratory methods and assay platforms is also relevant.

Data analysis and reporting

• Experience in analyzing, interpreting and presenting experimental data from both in vivo and in vitro studies.

• Ability to perform relevant statistical analyses, generate graphs and visualize experimental results.

• Experience in preparing clear and structured experimental reports and presenting study results and conclusions.

Other qualifications

• The optimal candidate will have obtained a PhD degree and have at least 4-5 years of experience from either pharma or biotech, or as a post doc.

• Good scientific project management and communications skills, and the ability to clearly and precisely present data to a professional audience.

• Good interpersonal skills, and the ability to thrive in a startup environment where flexibility and a can-do attitude is part of everyday work life.

• Fluent in the English language, written as well as spoken.
